text.body:
śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ ॥ omiti jñānamātreṇa rogājīrṇena nirjitā । kālanidrāṃ prapanno'smi trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 1॥
na gatirvidyate cānyā tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama । pāpapaṅke nimagnosmi trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 2॥
mohito mohajālena putradāragṛhādiṣu । tṛṣṇayā pīḍyamāno'smi trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 3॥
bhaktihīnaṃ ca dīnaṃ ca duḥkhaśokāturaṃ prabho । anāśrayamanāthaṃ ca trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 4॥
gatāgatenaśrāntosmi dīrghasaṃsāravatmarstu । yena bhūyo na gacchāmi trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 5॥
vahavo hi mayā dṛṣṭāḥ kleśāścaiva pṛthak pṛthak । garbhavāse mahadduḥkhaṃ trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 6॥
tena deva prapannosmi trāṇārthaṃ tvatparāyaṇaḥ । duḥkhārṇavaparitrāṇāt trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 7॥
vācā yacca pratijñātaṃ karmaṇā topapāditam । tatpāpārjitamagnosmi trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 8॥
sukṛtaṃ na kṛtaṃ kiñcidduṣkṛtaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mayā । saṃsāraghore magnosmi trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 9॥
dehāntarasahastreṣu cānyonyabhrāmito mayā । tiryaktvaṃ mānuṣtvaṃ ca trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 10॥
vācayāmi yathonmattaḥ pralapāmi tavāgrataḥ । jarāmaraṇabhītosmi trāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 11॥
yatra yatra ca yātosmi strīṣu vā puruṣeṣu ca । tatra tatrācalā bhaktistrāhi māṃ madhusūdana ॥ 12॥
gatvā gatvā nivartante candrasūryādayo grahāḥ । adyāpi na nibarttante dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ ॥ 13॥
ūrdhvapātālamartyeṣu vyāptaṃ lokaṃ jagattrayam । dvādaśākṣarātparaṃ nāsti vāsudevena bhāṣitam ॥ 14॥
dvādaśākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam । garbhavāsanivāsena śukena paribhāṣitam ॥ 15॥
dvādaśākṣaraṃ nirāhāro yaḥ yaḥ paṭhedharivāsare । sa gacchedvaiṣṇavasthānaṃ yatra yogeśvaro hariḥ ॥ 16॥
iti śrīśukadevaviracitaṃ madhusūdanastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam ॥
